name: Annual Reimbursable Meals Assurance
description: Annual assurance that District reimbursable-meal guidelines are not less restrictive than federal regulations.

preparers.name: Director of Business Services or designee

quote: An assurance that District guidelines for reimbursable meals are not less restrictive than regulations and guidelines issued for schools in accordance with federal law shall be provided (annually) by the Food Service Manager and/or the Director of Business Services or designee.
